7084-7272-8338.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7272-8338.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4687-4702-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least four counters on it.
4687-4702-5479.description:
Activate Splinter Twin by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte three times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping three lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {2}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1912-4687-5268.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4687-5268.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7230-8095.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost X or more life this turn.
6972-7230-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3525-4289-8039.description:
Activate Spireside Infiltrator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

654-1308-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6822-7824.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Lyla triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-7175.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1494-3017-6822-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2511-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
2511-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4478-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1308-1563-2457-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

465-3742-4251-4742-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
2079-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
2079-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

3532-4997-5078-5901.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-4997-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4050-5043-5078-6918.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

4289-4316-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

955-1170-1171.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
955-1170-1171.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

1992-2511-5994.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2511-5994.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Knight.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1548-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1548-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Port Razer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Maskwood Nexus, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Port Razer token.
The Port Razer token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Port Razer token.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

108-3129-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

277-5411-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
277-5411-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

1339-2034-5185-5362.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying {4}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of The Locust God.
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God and the Locust God token each trigger twice, creating a total of four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

215-2174-2404-3464.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-2174-2404-3464.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Juniper Order Druid any number of times.

800-3201-4613.notablePrerequisites: Knacksaw Clique does not have summoning sickness and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
800-3201-4613.description:
Activate Knacksaw Clique using Arixmethes' ability by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Knacksaw Clique by paying {2} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library.
Repeat.

2639-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mitotic Slime, adding {1}.
Mitotic Slime dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Ooze, adding {1}.
The Ooze dies, creating two 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Oozes, adding {2}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1494-2744-4239.notablePrerequisites: Tetravus has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
1494-2744-4239.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tetravus' first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve Tetravus' second ability, choosing not to exile any tokens.
Resolve Tetravus' first ability, causing you to remove five +1/+1 counters from Tetravus to create five 1/1 Tetravite creature tokens.
The Tetravites enter the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade five times, putting five +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

501-586-4050-5105.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {1}{B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {W}.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W}, returning Priest of Gix to hand.
Repeat.

1427-2047.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
1427-2047.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Masterful Replication by paying {5}{U}, causing all artifacts you control to become a copy of the artifact with Mechanized Production attached until end of turn.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, causing you to create a token of the artifact it is attached to and win the game.

412-618-5200-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
At least nine cards in your graveyard.
412-618-5200-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Ancestor's Chosen with haste.
The token enters gaining you 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

769-2034-4963.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
769-2034-4963.description:
Activate Words of Wilding.
The next time you would draw a card, create a 2/2 bear token.
Mentor of the Meek triggers.
Sacrifice the bear to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Before Mentor of the Meek resolves, activate Words of Wilding, replacing your next draw with the creation of a 2/2 bear.
Repeat for infinite ETB and LTB.

738-1969-4050-5004.description:
Sacrifice Cathodion to Phyrexian Altar, adding one mana of any color.
Cathodion and Grave Pact trigger.
Resolve Cathodion's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Grave Pact's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Cathodion to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
